prompt: A photorealistic photo presents a modern chemistry laboratory with precise scientific equipment and focused researchers. On the left, a scientist in a white lab coat and safety goggles examines a test tube containing a purple liquid, holding it up to the light. Next to her, a colleague writes notes on a clipboard, leaning against a stainless steel workbench. In the center, a complex distillation apparatus bubbles with clear fluid, connected by glass tubing to various flasks. A robotic arm adjusts a valve on the setup, demonstrating advanced technology. To the right, another researcher operates a microscope, peering intently into the eyepiece while adjusting the focus knob. Safety signs and chemical storage cabinets line the back wall, organized neatly. Overhead fluorescent lights provide bright, even illumination, reflecting off the polished surfaces. The floor is clean and tiled, with no clutter. The atmosphere is sterile and professional, emphasizing precision and safety. Each instrument is rendered with high fidelity, showing metallic sheens and glass transparency. The composition balances human activity with technological complexity. The style is a photorealistic photo, capturing the intricate details of a scientific environment.
